Hymn 101: Guide Me to Thee
Time Signature: 3/4
Musical Key: A-flat Major
Composer: Martin Shaw
Lyricist/Text Author: Orson Pratt Huish
Category: Prayer and Supplication

This is hymn number 101 titled "Guide Me to Thee" from the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints hymnbook. 
It is written in A-flat Major with a 3/4 time signature. 
The music was composed by Martin Shaw and the lyrics were written by Orson Pratt Huish.
This hymn is categorized under: Prayer and Supplication.
